name: shelf-invoices
description: The invoice NavAIgate sends, in our house design, made from your own company settings: numbered from your books, checked as a PDF and filed by year and month.

books_folder.title: Your invoices folder (optional)
books_folder.description: The folder that holds your company.json, drafts and filed invoices, for example ~/Documents/Invoices. Leave blank to use the folder `shelf-invoices init` remembers.
